^1=== CAP RES & DEX & INT WITH GEAR === Spectres: ^4Use two Carnage Chieftains from act 2 until you get Arena master & Pale Seraphim (ask in /global 6666 for Arena master & Pale Seraphim)
Early league start 3 spectre limit
1. Carnage Chieftain (act2 in "The old fields") 2. Arena master (Drox map) 3. ^xE05030^4Pale seraphim (Beyond mechanic) ^1(Replace this with Perfect forest warrior (damage) or Perfect guardian turtle(defense) as soon as possible)
^xE05030^1Note: ^4Currently a normal Forest warrior corpse says that it does not provide "Nearby allies have Onslaught" but it actually does, so you dont need a perfect to gain a permanent onslaught buff for your minions.
Finished Early setup 4 spectre limit
1. Carnage Cheiftan (act2 in "The old fields") 2. ^xE05030^4Perfect Forest warrior (Damage) 3. Perfect guardian turtle (Phys Defense) 4. Arena master (Drox map)
Over cap your resistances with +15 to negate elemental exposure.
^4Minion skill GEM LEVEL is much more important than QUALITY: 21/0 >>>> 20/20 Spectres/dps golems/skeletons/zombies/phantasm/AG
There is a div card that gives 21/0 vaal skeleton called ^1"The Bones"
^4You want one ghastly eye jewel with taunt on hit and one with bind on hit
You want "minions have a chance to poison on hit" on all your ghastly eye jewels to reach 100% chance to poison with minions. ^1This is a massive damage increase.^4
Dont use AG until total combined gem level for AG is at least lvl 15, "total combined gem level" = +1 skills from wand/helmet/shield
If you start mapping with bought or traded low ^xE05030level(1) minion gems^7 ^4you will have a ^1very bad time.
^xE05030Wake of destruction^7 ^4shock effect is 15% but the uptime is very unreliable so shock effect is set to 5% in config
As soon as you finish hungry loop your AG will become very tanky.
Swap to Solaris pantheon if you are going to fight end-game bosses that are mostly alone (Shaper/Eater/Exarch/Sirus/Uber elder/Maven)
^1!T17 MAPS! ^4Skip the abomination map boss until you have at least medium budget setup. (They can destroy your permanent minions and AG in seconds if you are unlucky)
^1Convocate ^4on top of tanky rares / bosses to focus dmg and to move your minions away from uber attacks that do a lot of damage. ^4(So dont use convocate with automation / trigger / cast when damage taken)
^xAF6025^5LOW BUDGET NOTE^7
^5^4^1^5Dendrobrate ^4is a good cheap option until you get enough "minions have a chance to poison on hit" jewels^7. ^x70FF70(Get extra dex and Int from jewels, cluster or ring if you need it)^7 ^5^4If you have more than 60% "minions have a chance to poison on hit" from jewels swap to covenant as soon as possible.
^x8888FFTestudo^4 is a very cheap anoint you can get early for high attack block chance, block recovery and 30 life each time you block an attack. You want to anoint Death attunemnent later when you can afford to get a Silver oil.
^1Helmet implicit ^4can be "minions have increased maximum life" instead of despair curse effect if you want tankier minions or +1 maximum lightning resistance.
^4Dont level Clarity and vitality to high, keep mana at minimum 87+ ^xE05030Why?^7 ^4(Shield charge (10mana) + trigger flesh offering (77mana) = 87mana)
For low budget AG body armour and boots use either ^xE05030Cospri + wake^7 or ^xE05030Garb + windscream^7 ^4(Garb is more expensive but makes you crit immune) ^4 Early 6L Covenant can do Uber Atziri/eater/cortex(depends on mods) if you ^xE05030play well^7 ^4and Uber Sirus&exarch if you ^xE05030play very well ^7^4(Get medium budget before doing uber uber Elder/Maven/Shaper, or ^xE05030play like a pro) ^1(If you play Hardcore, get at least the Mid gear for 100% Spell Suppression) ^4Difficulty Ubers: Atziri<<<<Cortex(Depends on mods)<Eater<<Exarch<Sirus<<Elder=Maven<Shaper Uber shaper+elder+Exarch+Sirus can wipe your minions at the Early game setup. (Make sure AG gem is lvl 21 before doing ubers) Vs Uber Sirus respec into protection mastery to get corrupted blood immunity.
